WITH site_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    sm.zoneref,
    s.insurstat,
    COUNT(*) as mesh_count,
    AVG(sm.facetresmm / sm.geomdeltamm) as site_avg_ratio
  FROM scanmesh sm
  JOIN sites s ON sm.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  WHERE sm.facetresmm IS NOT NULL 
    AND sm.geomdeltamm IS NOT NULL 
    AND sm.geomdeltamm > 0
    AND s.insurstat IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY sm.zoneref, s.insurstat
),
status_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    insurstat,
    AVG(site_avg_ratio) as status_avg_ratio
  FROM site_ratios
  GROUP BY insurstat
),
kept_sites AS (
  SELECT 
    sr.insurstat,
    sr.zoneref,
    sr.site_avg_ratio,
    sr.mesh_count,
    sa.status_avg_ratio
  FROM site_ratios sr
  JOIN status_averages sa ON sr.insurstat = sa.insurstat
  WHERE sr.site_avg_ratio > sa.status_avg_ratio
)
SELECT 
  insurstat,
  AVG(site_avg_ratio) as kept_sites_avg_ratio,
  SUM(mesh_count) as total_mesh_records,
  AVG(site_avg_ratio - status_avg_ratio) as avg_excess
FROM kept_sites
GROUP BY insurstat
